title: Pre-commit Hook + Conductor Scope Check
acceptance_criteria: AC-2: conductor scope check: task 分配在 conductor 权限内 (task.assign, testing.merge)
AC-3: conductor 尝试写 miao 被拒绝 (exit 1 + 审计日志)
AC-4: authz/check.sh 错误时 fail-closed (exit 1, 不 silent allow)
AC-5: authz/check.sh 包含 set -euo pipefail + SIGTERM handler
AC-6: conductor-scope.ts 验证 task 分配权限 (角色 ∈ [conductor, master])
AC-7: L1 存在性: ls .git/hooks/pre-commit + src/permissions/conductor-scope.ts
AC-8: L2 实质性: wc -c .git/hooks/pre-commit > 200 bytes
AC-9: L3 接线正确: bash -n .git/hooks/pre-commit 无语法错误
AC-10: L4 数据流动: 模拟 conductor 越权场景, 验证 hook 拒绝 (exit 1)
AC-11: 模拟 performer 尝试 merge 到 miao, 验证 hook 拒绝
AC-12: audit log 写入 .kallax/data/authz.db (role, action, result, timestamp)
p0_fixes: FIFO 非阻塞写 (防 session_start.sh 类卡死)
hot path Python 实现 (bash 无法达到 10ms)
